decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (2239-01/MT, 2239-02/MT/A, 2239-03/MT/C, 2239-04/MT/D and 2239-06/MTA received 8 August 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the ____________ wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the extension hereby approved is first occupied, a front boundary wall shall be built to match the existing front boundary in materials, design and dimensions to extend the existing front wall north-westwards across the front boundary so that the front wall is no less than six metres long when measured from the south-east corner of the front garden.  The new wall shall not exceed the height of the existing wall at any point and shall be permanently retained.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, first floor side extension, conversion of garage into habitable space, rear roof extension and roof lights to the house.
